business_rules: Tail's verdict on missing registry is error (a sensor cannot be running without the file).
behavior.summary: After registry.Lookup resolves the project root, the script tries to open running_sensors.json. If absent, emit verdict=error metadata.registry_exists=false; do not open signals.log.

description: Discovery variation: /tail-sensor on a project that has no .harness/runtime/running_sensors.json emits a verdict=error Signal — there is no way for a sensor to be running without the registry file. Distinct from /list-sensors which warns on the same condition.

evidence.rationale: Pre-lookup branch that distinguishes /tail-sensor's error semantics from /list-sensors' warn semantics.

expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has one error Signal carrying diagnostic metadata.

name: Error when registry file is absent (sensor cannot be running)

trigger.summary: Agent invokes /tail-sensor in a project root that has no registry file.
